ast.scope: Child source-bound partial syntax; no composed semantic AST.

obernants.assumptions: Source inspection covers CLI effects, but actual live corpus, teacher, frozen assessments, production DB/model data, downloads and lesson workflows excluded. No parser completeness, language accuracy or universal safety inferred from finite checks. Existing audit-before-guard and transitive-invalid-head caveats retained.
obernants.domain: Small synthetic strings/XML/arrays and tempfile model roundtrip under dedicated temp root. Scoring requires representable counts, column bounds, finite alpha>0 and nonnegative switch costs for objective model; rows nonempty10 fields, heads valid for tree/CoNLL-U helpers. Raw adversarial input outside those premises is not certified.
obernants.observation_scope: Real joins: cue form/name->features->count/logp columns; tokenize byte spans->segments->talmud slices; MACULA Node0-based -> head1-based -> surface permutation -> emitted-row head mapping; macula html_text->tanakh NFC edition; read_sentence open_after->next open_before within book. Counterexamples: copying MACULA ordinal to Tanakh order misaligns books; treating Segment.end as talmud slice end loses punctuation; union of component complements is not complement of composed relation. L/M are tagged siblings only.
obernants.operator: Under admitted states, L cannot emit neutral-only tokens or invalid path columns, M cannot choose Aramaic on majority tie, PD edition cannot admit wrong licence. The sibling universe is tagged transitions; neither path implies execution/effects of the other. These are partial source-derived exclusions, not exhaustive complements.
